Built a complete, playable browser game in `index.html`.

- Select **FIGHT** and time your strikes; dodge Sans’s bone and blaster attacks with the arrow keys or WASD.
- In phase two, Sans breaks the fight menu. Move through the arena to collect all three fragments, then press **Z/Enter** to restore it.
- **X/Esc** backs out; **ACT**, **ITEM**, and **MERCY** offer alternate actions.
- Includes keyboard and touch controls, health, win/game-over screens, and a replay option.

Assumption: this is a self-contained, fan-inspired take rather than a full recreation of the original game. I checked the game’s syntax and browser-rendered screens.
